mapper.select: SELECT Role, Status, COUNT(*) AS Total FROM dbo.[User] GROUP BY Role, Status
SELECT PublishStatus, COUNT(*) AS Total FROM dbo.Story WHERE IsDeleted = 0 GROUP BY PublishStatus

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Chapter c JOIN dbo.Story s ON s.StoryId = c.StoryId WHERE c.IsDeleted = 0 AND s.IsDeleted = 0 AND c.Status = 'PUBLISHED') AS PublishedChapters, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Chapter c JOIN dbo.Story s ON s.StoryId = c.StoryId WHERE c.IsDeleted = 0 AND s.IsDeleted = 0) AS TotalChapters, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(WordCount), 0) FROM dbo.Story WHERE IsDeleted = 0) AS TotalWords, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ViewCount), 0) FROM dbo.Story WHERE IsDeleted = 0) AS TotalViews, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Rating) AS TotalRatings
SELECT AS Period, SUM(CAST(d.Views AS BIGINT)) AS Views FROM dbo.StoryViewDaily d WHERE d.ViewDate BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY ORDER BY Period

SELECT g.GenreId, g.Name, g.Slug, COUNT(s.StoryId) AS StoryCount, COALESCE(SUM(s.ViewCount), 0) AS TotalViews FROM dbo.Genre g LEFT JOIN (dbo.StoryGenre sg JOIN dbo.vw_PublicStory s ON s.StoryId = sg.StoryId) ON sg.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name, g.Slug, g.SortOrder ORDER BY StoryCount DESC, g.SortOrder, g.GenreId

SELECT x.Month, x.Role, COUNT(*) AS Total FROM (SELECT u.Role, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(DATEADD(MINUTE, #{offsetMinutes}, u.CreatedAt)), MONTH(DATEADD(MINUTE, #{offsetMinutes}, u.CreatedAt)), 1) AS Month FROM dbo.[User] u WHERE u.CreatedAt >= #{sinceUtc}) x GROUP BY x.Month, x.Role ORDER BY x.Month, x.Role
mapper.sql: SELECT SUM(ViewCount) AS Total FROM dbo.Story WHERE IsDeleted = 0 GROUP BY AuthorId
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(AVG(CAST(t.Total AS DECIMAL(20,2))) AS DECIMAL(20,2)) FROM () t

SELECT TOP (#{limit}) a.UserId AS AuthorId, a.PenName, a.IsVerified, a.FollowerCount, COUNT(*) AS StoryCount, SUM(s.ViewCount) AS TotalViews FROM dbo.Story s JOIN dbo.Author a ON a.UserId = s.AuthorId WHERE s.IsDeleted = 0 GROUP BY a.UserId, a.PenName, a.IsVerified, a.FollowerCount HAVING SUM(s.ViewCount) > (SELECT AVG(CAST(t.Total AS DECIMAL(20,2))) FROM () t) ORDER BY TotalViews DESC, a.UserId
